as_told.title: Voice-to-skull technology known under another inside term

plain: The story is that the US government has a programme that beams microwaves at a person's head to make vibrations the brain hears as sound, and then shapes those vibrations into a voice, so that someone hears words no one else can. A former senior NSA official named Eric Haseltine describes it on the show as something he knows from the inside, saying microwaves can "create vibrations like sound" and that "there's a program to modulate that with voice. We call it the voice of God." A former Pentagon official named Matthew Brown, who presents himself as a whistleblower, tells a version of it too. He uses the public name, "voice to skull" technology, and calls it the crudest of a whole family of such tools. Brown adds that he never saw that programme himself on the inside and that he knows it by a different term, which he does not give. If true, it would mean the government can put a voice inside a person's head at a distance.
